Message.Name: Seconds Message
Message.Description: Sent every second for which at least one MDF message is being generated.

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Unix time (number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Message.Name: Order Book Directory Message
Message.Description: Disseminated at the start of each trading day for all active securities, including halted securities.

Field.Name: Order book ID
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book.

Field.Name: Asset name
Field.Description: Is currently always set to N/A

Field.Name: Number of decimals in Price
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals used in price for this order book.

Field.Name: Number of decimals in Nominal Value
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals in Nominal Value.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the quantity that represents a round lot for the issue.

Field.Name: Number of Legs
Field.Description: Number of legs. Only applicable for combination instruments

Field.Name: Commodity Code
Field.Description: ID of the Underlying instrument (Underlying Order Book ID)

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Date of expiration. 0 for instruments that do not have an Expiration date

Field.Name: Number of decimals in Strike Price
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals used in Strike Price for this order book.

Field.Name: Number of Tradable Equities
Field.Description: The number of shares/equities held by all shareholders (Currently set to 0)

Field.Name: Number of Outstanding Equities
Field.Description: The number of shares/equities available for trading at the exchange, also called floating shares (Currently set to 0).

Field.Name: Last Traded Date
Field.Description: This is the last date the asset can be traded.

Field.Name: Contract Multiplier
Field.Description: The number of Underlying Assets one unit of the derivatives contract is based on.

Field.Name: Multiplier
Field.Description: Specifies the ratio or multiply factor used to convert from contracts to shares.

Field.Name: Decimals In Multiplier
Field.Description: The number of decimals used for Multiplier or Contract Multiplier.

Field.Name: Min Order Quantity
Field.Description: For ASX this will be set to 1

Field.Name: Max Order Quantity
Field.Description: For ASX this is the Max value for the field

Field.Name: Number of Settlement Days
Field.Description: The number of settlement days applicable for trades in this order book

Field.Name: Alias Name
Field.Description: Alias name of orderbook. The Square Bracket Value from the LongName

Field.Name: Externally Price Sourced
Field.Description: Indicates if the Item is externally priced

Field.Name: Deliverable
Field.Description: Defines if a series can be delivered or not (cash settlement)

Field.Name: Foreign Ownership Restriction
Field.Description: Foreign ownership restriction. Incorporated outside country.

Field.Name: Last Trading Time
Field.Description: Used in conjunction with Last Traded Date. Set to null if no Last Trading time

Field.Name: Minimum Value for Initial Trade Report
Field.Description: The required minimum trade value for initial trade reports.

Field.Name: CFI Code
Field.Description: Currently it is set to blank. 6 Letter Code in line with the ISO Standard for Classification of Financial Instruments.

Field.Name: Upper-level series
Field.Description: The Upper-Level series. Only populated for instruments that have an Underlying.

Field.Name: Upper Series Level Order-book ID
Field.Description: The Order Book ID of the Upper-Level series. Zero otherwise.

Message.Name: Exchange Directory Message
Message.Description: Disseminated at the start of each trading day for all active Exchanges in the system.

Field.Name: Exchange ID
Field.Description: Exchange code. Exchange ID 255 is the default system exchange and contains no underlying tradable instruments.

Message.Name: Market Directory Message
Message.Description: Disseminated at the start of each trading day for all active Markets in the system.

Field.Name: Index Market
Field.Description: Indicates if the market is an Index Market.

Message.Name: Combination Order Book Leg Directory Message
Message.Description: Provides a mapping between a combination order book and one of the combination leg order books.

Field.Name: Combination Order book ID
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book.

Field.Name: Leg Order book ID
Field.Description: Order book ID of Leg instrument

Message.Name: Tick Size Table Entry Message
Message.Description: Contains information on a tick size for a price range.

Field.Name: Order book ID
Field.Description: The order book this entry belongs to.

Field.Name: Tick Size
Field.Description: Tick Size for the give price range

Field.Name: Price From
Field.Description: Start of price range for this entry. Always set to 4 decimals

Field.Name: Price To
Field.Description: End of price range for this entry. Zero (0) means infinity.

Message.Name: Corporate Action Entry Message
Message.Description: Displays the entries of assigned Corporate Action Codes to Order Books.

Field.Name: Corporate Action ID
Field.Description: Identifier of a Corporate Action. (Currently set to 0)

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: The order book for which the Corporate Action applies.

Field.Name: Corporate Action Code
Field.Description: The name of the CA Code (Appendix 1).

Field.Name: Corporate Action Type
Field.Description: The type of the CA Code.

Field.Name: Start Date
Field.Description: The first date the CA is active. (Currently set to 0)

Field.Name: End Date
Field.Description: The last date the CA is active. (Currently set to 0)

Field.Name: Record Date
Field.Description: The record date for the CA. Informational field only. (Currently set to 0)

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Currently set to 0. This field will be used in future releases

Message.Name: Order Book Directory Extension Message
Message.Description: Provides additional information that are valid only for Fixed Income instruments; sent for all instruments.

Field.Name: Order book ID
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book.

Field.Name: Coupon Interest
Field.Description: Coupon interest for the underlying. Only applicable for interest related underlyings

Field.Name: Coupon From Date
Field.Description: Dated date. Contains the date of the underlying from when the coupon interest is calculated.

Field.Name: Issue Date
Field.Description: Contains the issue date of the underlying if it has a limited lifetime.

Field.Name: Maturity Date
Field.Description: Contains the maturity date of the underlying if it has a limited lifetime.

Field.Name: Rate Determination Days
Field.Description: Specifies number of rate determination days

Field.Name: First Settlement Date
Field.Description: First settlement date in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: Coupon Div Date
Field.Description: Coupon date for bond underlying or dividend date for stock underlying.

Field.Name: Date Books Close
Field.Description: Books close date for bond underlying.

Field.Name: Effective Expiration Date
Field.Description: The effective expiration date is the actual expiration date of the series.

Field.Name: Proceed Date
Field.Description: Proceed date for fixed income underlying.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Message.Name: Order Book State Message
Message.Description: Relays information on state changes.

Field.Name: State Name
Field.Description: Name of the Order Book State

Field.Name: Display Name
Field.Description: The display name of the state

Message.Name: Business Date Message
Message.Description: Relays information on the current business date.

Message.Name: End of Recovery Message
Message.Description: Received when a recovery is done and it has reached the end.

Message.Name: Instrument Status Message
Message.Description: Received when the State of an Instrument is changed at any of the applicable levels.

Field.Name: Trading State Name
Field.Description: Name of the State. NoState means the previous state at Instrument Series level or Underlying Level has been removed.

Field.Name: Name of the Instrument State Level
Field.Description: Name of the applicable Instrument State level.

Field.Name: Start Time
Field.Description: Start Time. Leading zeros are removed in this field

Message.Name: Equilibrium Price Message
Message.Description: Used when auctions occur; provides the changes in equilibrium price.

Field.Name: Available Bid Quantity at Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Quantity at equilibrium price on the bid side

Field.Name: Available Ask Quantity at Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Quantity at equilibrium price on the ask side

Field.Name: Equilibrium Quantity
Field.Description: The tradable quantity at equilibrium price

Message.Name: Market by Price Message
Message.Description: Publishes order book Prices per Price level.

Field.Name: Maximum Level
Field.Description: The maximum price level. Price levels above Maximum Level shall be deleted by a consumer.

Field.Name: Number of Level items
Field.Description: The number of times the item fields below are repeated.

Message.Name: Trade Statistics Message
Message.Description: Publishes Trade Statistics per Orderbook ID for the current Trading Day.

Field.Name: Open Price
Field.Description: Open price of the Order Book.

Field.Name: High Price
Field.Description: Highest price of the Order Book during the current day.

Field.Name: Low Price
Field.Description: Lowest price of the Order Book during the current day.

Field.Name: Turnover Quantity
Field.Description: Calculated as sum of Traded Quantity. Includes Reported Trades Quantity.

Field.Name: Reported Trades Turnover Quantity
Field.Description: Calculated as sum of Reported Trades Quantity.

Field.Name: Turnover Value
Field.Description: Calculated as sum of Traded Price * Traded Quantity.

Message.Name: Reference Price Message
Message.Description: Publishes Reference Prices per Price Types.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time (in UTC) when the Price was updated (if available).

Field.Name: Price Date
Field.Description: The date of the price. Implemented as the date of the updated time stamp in Local time.

Message.Name: Index Message
Message.Description: Used for sending index price information.

Message.Name: Open Interest Message
Message.Description: Publishes Open Interest.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Currently set to -9223372036854775808 (minimum value of an 8 byte signed integer).

Message.Name: Trade Ticker Message
Message.Description: Publishes Trade Ticker.

Field.Name: As of Date
Field.Description: As of Date if populated, else zero

Field.Name: BOQ List
Field.Description: Corporate action codes. May be null filled.

Field.Name: Participant ID Buy
Field.Description: Participant ID of participant on Buy side if public. Null otherwise.

Field.Name: Order ID Buy
Field.Description: ID of order on buy side if public. Zero otherwise.

Field.Name: Participant ID Sell
Field.Description: Participant ID of participant on Sell side if public. Null otherwise.

Field.Name: Order ID Sell
Field.Description: ID of order on sell side if public. Zero otherwise.

Message.Name: Price Limits Message
Message.Description: Provides an update to the price limits or circuit breaker limits for an order book.

Field.Name: Order book ID
Field.Description: The Order book the Price Limits update is for

Field.Name: Upper Limit
Field.Description: The Upper Price Limit. Min Long Value means limit is removed/no limits

Field.Name: Lower Limit
Field.Description: The Lower Price Limit. Min Long Value means limit is removed/no limits

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: The reference price used for the calculated static or dynamic Price limits

Message.Name: Market Announcement Message
Message.Description: Publishes Market Announcements for Order Books, Markets, Underlyings or Exchanges.

Field.Name: Order book ID
Field.Description: If field is not used then the value 0 is used.

Field.Name: Exchange ID
Field.Description: If field is not used then the value 0 is used.

Field.Name: Market ID
Field.Description: If field is not used then the value 0 is used.

Field.Name: Message Information Type
Field.Description: Kind of message sent in announcement.

Field.Name: Message Source
Field.Description: A description of the source of the message, e.g. the market control.

Field.Name: Document URL
Field.Description: The URL link where more information may be found, typically a document.

Field.Name: Number of Message Items
Field.Description: The number of message items in the following array. A maximum of 10 items may be used.

Field.Name: Number of Messages Items
Field.Description: Duplicate field of Number of Message Items. Not used for current encoding

Field.Name: Array of Message items
Field.Description: Array with rows in the message. Each row has a maximum of 80 characters.

Field.Name: Commodity Code
Field.Description: The commodity code of the underlying if sent on underlying level. Zero otherwise.

Message.Name: End of Snapshot Message
Message.Description: Returns the current MDF sequence number to be used when connecting to the MDF feed (Glimpse).

Field.Name: Snapshot Sequence Number
Field.Description: MDF SoupBin TCP sequence number when the snapshot was taken, in ASCII.

Field.Name: Level
Field.Description: The numeric order of the price level, where 1 is the first price level.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price for the Level. Not used for a Price Delete Item.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Visible quantity for the Level. 0 and not used for a Price Delete Item.

Field.Name: Number of Deletes
Field.Description: Number of Levels deleted in this update. Used for a Price Delete Item.

Field.Name: Number of orders
Field.Description: Number of orders at this level.

Value.Name: Undefined
Value.Description: Put or Call is undefined for the order book

Value.Name: Cum Equal Access Buyback
Value.Description: Cum Equal Access Buyback (Basis of quotation)

Value.Name: One Tenth of a Price Step
Value.Description: One Tenth of a Price Step (Status note)

Value.Name: Ex Return of Capital
Value.Description: Ex Return of Capital (Basis of quotation)

Value.Name: Ex Equal Access Buyback
Value.Description: Ex Equal Access Buyback (Basis of quotation)

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Start of Messages. Outside of time stamp messages, the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. Always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Done for day
Value.Description: Done for day. No More Trades, Trade Reporting Done for Day

Value.Name: New
Value.Description: New price level added, or the number of price levels reduced with contents changed

Value.Name: Change
Value.Description: Number of price levels remain the same but the contents of the price level changed

Value.Name: Delete From
Value.Description: Price level removed compared to the last update

Value.Name: Matched outside exchange different brokers
Value.Description: Matched outside exchange, different brokers, trade report.

Value.Name: Matched outside exchange one broker
Value.Description: Matched outside exchange, one broker, trade report, crossing.

Value.Name: Standard Combination matched
Value.Description: Standard Combination order matched against another combination order or against a single order by the exchange electronically.

Value.Name: Tmc order matched
Value.Description: TMC order matched against another combination order or against a single order by the exchange electronically.

Value.Name: Booked Unintentional Crossing Prevention
Value.Description: Booked transaction, resulting from Unintentional Crossing Prevention.

Value.Name: Booked Unintentional Crossing Prevention Auction
Value.Description: Booked transaction, resulting from Unintentional Crossing Prevention during an auction.

Value.Name: Booked Centre Point Unintentional Crossing Prevention
Value.Description: Booked transaction in Centre Point, resulting from Unintentional Crossing Prevention.

Value.Name: Centre Point Any Price Block Trade
Value.Description: Centre Point Any Price Block Trade.

Value.Name: Preference Centre Point Any Price Block Trade
Value.Description: Preference Centre Point Any Price Block Trade

Value.Name: Buy Write Internal Trade Crossing
Value.Description: Buy Write (Equity/Derivative Combination) which is an Internal Trade/Crossing
